dict.string: This app requires microphone access to transcribe your speech into text.

This app does not access the Photo Library, however, this app uses react-native-permissions which is causing automated revision to detect usage. react-native-permissions makes a reference to this API, but the app does not actually use the Photo Library, and it will not request access from the user. react-native-permissions is used by this app to handle checking and requesting permissions for the microphone and speech recognition services.
